svg.text: ESP32 DevKit V1 pin map (30 pins)
Seen from above: antenna at the top, USB connector at the bottom. Board label (D13) = GPIO number in code (13).
ADC1 (GPIO 32–39) can still read analog values while Wi-Fi is on; ADC2 can't. GPIO 0 (BOOT button) and GPIO 6–11 (flash memory)
aren't broken out on 30-pin boards — don't use them on 38-pin boards. The built-in blue LED is on GPIO 2.
